findings.issue: The round-3 minor is only half fixed. env-descriptions.json now says 'A blank value keeps the default.' for USER_REFERRAL_IP_RETENTION, but the generated environment-variables.md row (line 172 in the worktree) still ends 'Blank is a startup error.'. summary: Request changes for one docs/CI issue. The default-off change in the code is complete. ip-lookback defaults to Duration.ZERO in both UserProperties and application.yml (`${USER_REFERRAL_IP_LOOKBACK:0}`). While it is 0, view() skips recordActivity, claim() never calls fingerprint.hash so claim_ip_hash is stored as NULL, and refuseIfAbusive skips the IP query. A grep of the worktree finds no Compose or Helm value that turns it back on. The purge job and account deletion are unaffected. Test coverage holds up. ReferralIpCheckDefaultOffIntegrationTest runs with the default config: it asserts lookback is ZERO, and a same-IP claim on an aged code succeeds with no ip_activity row and a NULL claim hash. The existing IP-check tests (RAI, MVC, account deletion, Tomcat) now set ip-lookback=30d explicitly, and CFG uses 1d, so AC-3/4/5/6/7/13/15 are still covered. The UserPropertiesValidationTest blank-env case now expects ZERO. The round-3 nit is resolved: the gateway Helm change is recorded as a scope deviation in objective.md, the OIDC post-deploy check is noted, and TD-SEC-15 is filed in the README, infra-security.md and remediation-plan.md. The requireDuration message is reworded. The round-3 minor is only partly done: env-descriptions.json was corrected, but the generated docs/reference/environment-variables.md still says 'Blank is a startup error.' for USER_REFERRAL_IP_RETENTION. The md is therefore stale, and the CI `env-reference.mjs --check` would fail. Regenerating the file fixes it. Phase and remediation docs are otherwise consistent with the default-off decision. I found no regressions in the delta.
